title: Taiwan Express Chili: Characteristics
metaDescription: Taiwan Express chili is a chili variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Taiwan Express is a chili variety, also sold or known as Taiwan Express hot pepper. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Harbest Agribusiness (Seeds of Hope).

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Taiwan Express chili is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Taiwan Express hot pepper, this is the same chili. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [chili variety finder](/crop-varieties/chili), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).
Key facts about Taiwan Express chili

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: 106 to 113 days after sowing. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit chili fields most often: [tomato leaf curl](/diseases/tomato-leaf-curl), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 106 to 113 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Pointed red fruits 4 to 6 cm long and 6 to 8 g, very hot.

blocks.text: These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual chili on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Taiwan Express chili

Decide first between siling haba, the long green finger chili for cooking, and siling labuyo, the small hot one. Hybrids bear more and for longer, while open pollinated labuyo keeps its heat and lets you save seed. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Taiwan Express hot pepper the same as Taiwan Express?
items.a: Yes. Taiwan Express hot pepper is another name for Taiwan Express. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Taiwan Express?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
